content_data.meeting_title: Redesign Sprint Planning: Q3 Promotional Campaign Visuals
agenda_items: Brainstorm fresh visual concepts for upcoming Q3 promotions, focusing on engagement and conversion
Review current campaign performance metrics and user feedback data
Discuss brand guideline updates and their impact on new design elements
key_decisions: Adopt a more minimalist aesthetic with vibrant color accents for the core Q3 campaign visuals to align with recent market trends.
Integrate user-generated content (UGC) elements into select promotional assets to boost authenticity.
action_items: Creative Director to provide updated brand mood boards incorporating minimalist aesthetic by end of next business cycle.
Lead Designer to mock up 3-5 distinct visual concepts for the primary campaign banner within the next 5 days.
Marketing Analyst to provide detailed demographic data for key regional targets by next week's sync.
Content Strategist to draft placeholder copy for initial design concepts by the end of this week.
Design team to research and compile examples of successful UGC integration in e-commerce marketing by the upcoming team meeting.
